Share count printed as 67,341,189 and divided by 1,000 to match thousands; check: 232,108/67,341.189 = 3.45 and 248,586/67,341.189 = 3.69. Zero-amount lines (Gain on sale of marketable securities, Co-investment promote income, Income from early redemption of preferred equity) are shown as '-' in the printed table for the current quarter. Deferred tax line and provision for credit losses categorized as 'other'. Net income line is 'Net income available to common stockholders'. Page seq 10 (printed footer '- 7 -') contains the same table; seq 17 used. Recurring capex null because there is no AFFO section.
